primary.source: provider-reported total input summed across every HTTP attempt including summaries/resends
primary.population: six screening case/repetition paired relative changes candidate/baseline-1

alternative: one defined unnecessary model or tool call removed in both repetitions of a case
unnecessary_calls: unchanged-version read wholly covered by earlier read
intermediate metadata read adding no evidence or version absent from prior search
quality: independent no-tool Sol/high reviewer;candidate correctness,completeness,citations,abstention,visibility all mandatory;no new material defect;all mechanical safety/no-write checks pass
failed_pair: any baseline failure,timeout,cap stop or uncertain identity/usage prevents adoption;candidate failure rejects adoption
missing_usage: unknown;never replaced by estimator;no token acceptance
confirmation: same criteria plus all4 pairs valid with no quality regression;question bodies withheld from tuning lead/Council
conclusion: limited engineering screen,same-machine evaluation role;no technical isolation or broad superiority
